## How it was checked

- [ ] `yarn verify` passes
- [ ] Tried on a device or emulator, if it changes what the app shows (say which: iOS or Android, and the screen)
- [ ] New user-facing text is in `constants/strings.ts`, and colours and spacing come from `constants/`
- [ ] That directory's own checks pass, if it touches `admin-dashboard/`, `translate/` or `social/`
